docs.title: Surprise Random 2-Digit Number Generator
docs.text: A simple web application that generates random 2-digit numbers from 00 to 99, 3-digit numbers from 000 to 999, 4-digit numbers from 0000 to 9999 with a chance to see a surprise number.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Generates random 2-digit numbers (00-99), 3-digit numbers (000-999), and 4-digit numbers (0000-9999)
  • Includes a surprise number feature
  • Simple and intuitive user interface
  • Instant generation on button click

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: Click the "Generate Number" button to display a random 2-digit number, 3-digit number, or 4-digit number. Occasionally, a surprise number will appear!

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository or download the source code
  2. Open index.html in your web browser
  3. Click the "Generate Number" button to start generating random numbers
